_meta.description: Trickster subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: debuff control, evasion, resource sustain.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la duree des debuffs infliges de 1.2% et la precision de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases debuff duration inflicted by 1.2% and accuracy by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente l'esquive de 0.8% et la resistance aux debuffs de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases evasion by 0.8% and debuff resistance by 0.5% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente l'ATK de 0.8% et le Souffle max de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases ATK by 0.8% and max Breath by 0.5% per level.
